parts:
Hi there!

For my project now on glimmer.rstudio.org/clange/MSBL/, I always get the following output. _Something_, and I don't know what, might go wrong when uploading a file (there's an example file in my MSBL app directory).

---------------
[15:30:35.363] Loading required package: MALDIquantForeign
Loading required package: MALDIquant

Listening on port 37147
ERROR: [on_request_read] parse error
/tmp/Rtmpfr2WPa/2d7c7e4ca3ce77f58e2b6f74/0
arguments 'minimized' and 'invisible' are for Windows only
Error in import(path = path, type = "fid", ...) :
  ‘/tmp/Rtmpfr2WPa/file6ec646ab7d74’ doesn't exist or isn't readable!
---------------

The first output of '/tmp/...' originates from a cat in my code to print the file upload path. But: I cannot even look into that dir, bevore it gets wiped. Any tips on debugging strategy?

... the code runs ok on a non-server shiny.

Cheers
Christoph

On Monday, March 11, 2013 10:16:49 PM UTC+1, Joe Cheng [RStudio] wrote:
Running "npm install -g shiny-server" as root will do it.

Great, thanks. Does work locally on the server now, but alas, not remotely in my setup: I have shiny-server running in a virtual machine (virtualbox) without a real own IP address: I port-forward the shiny-server port onto my host machine. I then get the following message when trying to load a file:

  Error in data.frame(name = file$name, size = file$size, type = file$type,  :
  arguments imply differing number of rows: 1, 0

But dont't mind, if it doesn't bother you and shouldn't necessarily work. I suspect it's something about port forwarding and WebSockets ... I'll cry for help again if things don't change with a _real_ server with own IP address (which I hope to get from our admins in the next couple of days).

On the other hand, if your're interested in this problem, I could provide you with more debugging output, just tell me what would be necessary to know.

-Christoph

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("shiny", "jcheng5")
